title: campanula lanceolata var. major
intro: Campanula lanceolata var. major, commonly known as the Large-leaved Bellflower, is a perennial plant species in the family Campanulaceae. It is a flowering plant with potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The therapeutic actions of Campanula lanceolata var. major include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, antidiabetic, and antiviral activities, making it a subject of interest in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
